_note: Constants shared by every city. Edit this file, then run scripts/fetch-climate.mjs to regenerate the city files. Surface solar values for the vertical facades are still placeholders. Replace them with values processed from each city's EPW file when available.

source.method: Medians across years of annual peaks, as described in scripts/fetch-climate.mjs.

calibration._note: Lumped-capacitance term that stands in for thermal mass and conduction to the indoor air. Tuned so an unshaded 2-storey brick house peaks near 39 °C indoors. Replace with a proper dynamic simulation later.

energy._note: Baseline cooling demand is the reference demand for Delhi, scaled by each city's cooling degree-hours (May–June, above the comfort temperature). Reference demand is an assumption, not measured data. Tariff and grid carbon are Delhi-based and apply to every city for now.
